title: S.R.&O. 8 of 2026 Representation of the People (Election Symbols) (Amendment) Regulations
text:
A 103
2026 Representation of the People (Election Symbols) SRO. 8
(Amendment) Regulations
GRENADA
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS NO. 8 OF 2026
The Governor-General in exercise of the powers conferred on her pursuant
to section 107 (1) of the Representation of the People Act Cap. 286A,
hereby makes the following Regulations–
(Gazetted 22nd May, 2026).
1. Citation. These Regulations may be cited as the
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (ELECTION SYMBOLS)
(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2026.
2. Interpretation. In these Regulations–
“principal Regulations” means the Representation of the People (Election
Symbols) Regulations Cap. 286A.
3. Amendment of the Schedule to the principal Regulations. The Schedule of
the principal Regulations is amended by inserting after item no. 39. the following–
“40. Symbol The Compass ”.
Made by the Governor-General this 20th day of April, 2026.
CCÉÉCCIILLEE EE.. FF.. LLAA GGRREENNAADDEE
Governor-General.
____________
Approved by the House of Representatives this 28th day of April, 2026.
FINLEY JEFFREY
Clerk to the House of Representatives.
GRENADA
PRINTED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, AT THE GOVERNMENT
PRINTING OFFICE, ST. GEORGE’S
22/5/2026.
